senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Koheleth, traditional surname of King Solomon.
units: Koh. R. to I, 1 למה נקרא שמו ק׳ … בהִקָּהֵל וכ׳ why was his name Koheleth? Because his words were proclaimed in public meeting, as it is written (I Kings VIII, 1) &c.; a. e.—ק׳ (ספר) the Book of Koheleth, Ecclesiastes.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 14b:11">B. Bath. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>סידרן … ק׳ וכ׳</he> the order of the books of Hagiographa is: Ruth, Psalms, Job, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes &c. Ib. 15ᵃ <he>משלי … ק׳ אנשי וכ׳</he> the men of the Great Assembly composed Proverbs, Song of Songs and Ecclesiastes.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30b:7">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בקשו … ספר ק׳ וכ׳</he> the scholars wanted to exclude from the canon (v. <cite ref="C01120"><he>גָּנַז</he></cite>) the book of E., because its words contradict one another; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:3:1">Koh. R. to I, 3</cite>; a. fr.
